course.title: Unit 2 No Rules, No Order【例句】
course.description: Section B How can rules help us?

sentences.content: What are some of the rules in your home?
sentences.english: What are some of the rules in your home ?
sentences.chinese: 你家里有哪些规矩？

sentences.content: Help! There are too many rules in my life!
sentences.english: Help ! There are too many rules in my life !
sentences.chinese: 救命啊！我生活中的规矩也太多了！

sentences.content: Every morning,
sentences.english: Every morning
sentences.chinese: 每个清晨，

sentences.content: I have to make my bed before breakfast.
sentences.english: I have to make my bed before breakfast
sentences.chinese: 我必须在早餐前整理好床铺。

sentences.content: I have to hurry to school because I can’t be late for school.
sentences.english: I have to hurry to school because I can't be late for school
sentences.chinese: 我得赶紧去学校，因为上学不能迟到。

sentences.content: When I’m at school,
sentences.english: When I'm at school
sentences.chinese: 当我在学校时，

sentences.content: I mustn’t use my phone in class either.
sentences.english: I mustn't use my phone in class either
sentences.chinese: 我也不可以在课堂上使用手机。

sentences.content: And I have to wear the uniform.
sentences.english: And I have to wear the uniform
sentences.chinese: 而且我还得穿制服。

sentences.content: After school, there are even more rules!
sentences.english: After school , there are even more rules !
sentences.chinese: 放学后，规矩更多了！

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时复数）: 构成现在进行时或复数形式

sentences.content: I have to finish my homework first.
sentences.english: I have to finish my homework first
sentences.chinese: 我得先完成我的作业。

sentences.content: I can only play basketball after I practise the piano.
sentences.english: I can only play basketball after I practise the piano
sentences.chinese: 我只有练完钢琴后才能打篮球。

sentences.content: I can’t hang out with my friends on weekdays.
sentences.english: I can't hang out with my friends on weekdays
sentences.chinese: 工作日我没法和朋友们出去玩。

sentences.content: I know some rules are important, but this is awful! What can I do?
sentences.english: I know some rules are important , but this is awful ! What can I do ?
sentences.chinese: 我知道有些规矩很重要，但这太糟糕了！我能怎么办？

sentences.content: Yes, there are many rules in life!
sentences.english: Yes , there are many rules in life !
sentences.chinese: 是啊，生活中有许多规则！

sentences.content: But they can help you to become a better person.
sentences.english: But they can help you to become a better person
sentences.chinese: 但它们能帮助你成为一个更好的人。

sentences.content: You mustn’t be late for class.
sentences.english: You mustn't be late for class
sentences.chinese: 上课绝不能迟到。

sentences.content: That shows respect for your class and teacher.
sentences.english: That shows respect for your class and teacher
sentences.chinese: 这体现了对课堂和老师的尊重。

wordDetails.definition: show（第三人称单数）: 展示

sentences.content: You can’t use your phone in class because you need to focus on learning.
sentences.english: You can't use your phone in class because you need to focus on learning
sentences.chinese: 课堂上不能使用手机，因为你需要专注于学习。

sentences.content: You have to wear a uniform because it builds school spirit.
sentences.english: You have to wear a uniform because it builds school spirit
sentences.chinese: 你必须穿校服，因为这能培养校园精神。

wordDetails.definition: build（第三人称单数现在时）: 建立

sentences.content: You can also think about the things you can do!
sentences.english: You can also think about the things you can do !
sentences.chinese: 你也可以想想自己能做的事情！

sentences.content: You can use your phone at home.
sentences.english: You can use your phone at home
sentences.chinese: 你可以在家里使用手机。

sentences.content: You can relax after you finish your homework.
sentences.english: You can relax after you finish your homework
sentences.chinese: 你可以在完成作业后放松一下。

sentences.content: And you can hang out with friends at weekends!
sentences.english: And you can hang out with friends at weekends !
sentences.chinese: 你还可以在周末和朋友一起出去玩！

sentences.content: I know it’s hard, but rules can help to make the world better.
sentences.english: I know it's hard , but rules can help to make the world better
sentences.chinese: 我知道这很难，但规则有助于让世界变得更美好。

sentences.content: Remember: No rules, no order!
sentences.english: Remember : No rules , no order !
sentences.chinese: 记住：没有规矩，不成方圆！
